points.quote: Create the identifier with `createDecorator<IFooService>('fooService')` from `instantiation.ts`. It is usually exported under the same name as the interface
Add the service as a constructor parameter decorated with its identifier: @IFooService private readonly fooService: IFooService

Contribution types are also created through `createInstance`. These include workbench contributions (`registerWorkbenchContribution2`), editor panes, and views. Services therefore arrive automatically.
